watches.name: Tissot PRX Powermatic 80
watches.look: steel case, rose-gold bezel, white waffle ("tapisserie") dial, integrated bracelet [EDIT: confirm size (35 or 40 mm) and reference]
watches.comment: The first watch I ever bought with my own money, and it became my daily beater. I fell in love with the waffle dial, and with how the Powermatic 80 movement runs for 80 hours, about double what a typical automatic gives you.

watches.name: Hamilton Khaki Field Murph
watches.look: black dial, steel case, field-watch numerals, needle seconds hand [EDIT: confirm 38 or 42 mm — the Morse-code seconds hand is on the 42 mm]
watches.comment: The perfect blend of elegance, cultural relevance and utilitarian design. Fun fact: "Eureka" is printed in Morse code along the seconds hand, what Murph shouts in Interstellar when she solves the gravity equation with the data sent through her watch's second hand.

watches.name: Vacheron Constantin FiftySix
watches.look: steel FiftySix self-winding, 40 mm, open caseback showing the Maltese cross rotor (ref. 4600E/000A-B487)
watches.comment: The first watch my father gave me, for my 19th birthday. An elegant, subtle dress watch for a collector's eye: it draws on the 6073 from 1956, and the open caseback shows the signature Maltese cross. It has come to mean a lot to me, a family legacy I'll one day pass down to my own children.
